name: Akkub
overview: Akkub appears in Scripture as a figure associated with the post-exilic community, identified both as one of the Nethinim, the temple servants or porters, and as a son of Elioenai. The books of Ezra and Nehemiah list Akkub among the families of gatekeepers who returned from exile to serve in the restored temple, emphasizing his role in maintaining the worship and order of God's house. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 3:24 highlights Akkub's lineage as a descendant of Elioenai, linking him to the broader genealogical heritage of Israel. These references collectively show Akkub's significance within the faithful remnant dedicated to God's service after the Babylonian captivity.
